General Info

- Department: DataOps / IT

- Work time Percentage: 100%

- Location: Geneva

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

DataOps Service & Governance Engineer

DataOps Services’ mission is to ensure the reliable and efficient servicing of all data interfaces supported by our data platform. This includes a broad spectrum of interfaces, ranging from highly critical order-processing flows to regular analytical and reporting systems. The DataOps team supports global systems serving the entire Group worldwide.

We are looking for a reliable and well-organised expert to join our DataOps team in Geneva. As our platform and data landscape evolve, robust operational governance has become increasingly important. With growing regulatory requirements, rising business expectations for data quality, and the need for consistent service delivery, we must ensure that our processes are well-documented, controlled, and transparent.

In this context, we are seeking a profile dedicated to overseeing documentation, managing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring Service Level Agreements (SLAs). By reinforcing these governance pillars, you will help us ensure continuity and quality of operations, while facilitating clear communication and alignment among our technical and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate operational activities related to data integration services under the responsibility of the DataOps Team Manager, ensuring effective change management, quality assurance, SLA monitoring, and comprehensive SOP documentation.

- Monitor and track the smooth operation of critical business processes, acting as the primary contact for SLA- and procedure-related topics.

- Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation and operational procedures (SOPs) to ensure alignment with internal standards, audit requirements, and applicable regulations.

- Collaborate closely with IT, production support, and business teams to strengthen governance around data integration processes and ensure documentation is accurate, up to date, and consistently applied.

- Ensure traceability, consolidation, and regular updates of performance indicators (KPIs) related to SLAs, operational quality, and service reliability.

- Prepare and contribute to regular service reviews and reporting, highlighting risks, issues, and improvement opportunities.

- Improve internal team processes by gathering stakeholder feedback, identifying pain points, and proposing optimisations to SOPs and workflows in collaboration with the line manager.

- Support incident and problem management from a governance perspective (e.g. post-incident documentation, lessons learned, action follow-up).

- Facilitate effective communication and coordination across teams to support operational excellence and a culture of continuous improvement.

Requirements and Qualifications

- At least 5 years of experience in operational governance, documentation management, service management, or PMO roles within a data-driven or IT/operations environment (e.g. data platforms, integration, production support).

- Proven experience in managing and monitoring SLAs and SOPs, with the ability to structure, validate, implement, and track procedures across multiple stakeholders.

- Strong writing, organisational, and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to produce clear, concise, and audit-ready documentation.

- Experience in tracking performance indicators (KPIs), preparing service quality reports, and presenting findings to management and stakeholders.

- Good understanding of data integration and data platform environments; knowledge of Kafka, Opcon orchestrator, microservice architectures, and REST-based communication is a strong plus.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to facilitate coordination across teams.

- High attention to detail, rigor, and autonomy in managing tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

- Good command of spoken and written English; French is an asset.

Personal Attributes

- Responsible and reliable, especially during critical operational periods and in the context of production incidents or major changes.

- Methodical, structured, and rigorous in documentation, process management, and follow-up.

- Proactive and a strong team player, with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional and international teams.

- Curious and motivated to learn and grow in a transforming technological environment, embracing change and continuous improvement.

- Comfortable challenging the status quo constructively and proposing pragmatic, risk-aware solutions.

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni generali
- Dipartimento: DataOps / IT
- Tempo di lavoro Percentuale: 100%
- Posizione: Ginevra

La nostra azienda

EFG International è un gruppo bancario privato globale, che offre servizi di private banking e asset management. Serviamo clienti in oltre 40 sedi in tutto il mondo. EFG International offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico e si sforza di essere un datore di lavoro di scelta.

Il nostro scopo e missione

Incoraggiare le menti imprenditoriali a creare valore – oggi e per il futuro.

Descrizione del lavoro

DataOps Service & Governance Engineer

La missione di DataOps Services è quella di garantire il servizio affidabile ed efficiente di tutte le interfacce di dati supportate dalla nostra piattaforma dati. Questo include un ampio spettro di interfacce, che vanno dai flussi di elaborazione degli ordini altamente critici ai sistemi analitici e di reporting regolari. Il team DataOps supporta sistemi globali che servono l'intero Gruppo in tutto il mondo.

Stiamo cercando un esperto affidabile e ben organizzato per unirsi al nostro team di DataOps a Ginevra. Mentre la nostra piattaforma e il panorama dei dati si evolvono, la robusta governance operativa è diventata sempre più importante. Con crescenti requisiti normativi, crescenti aspettative di business per la qualità dei dati e la necessità di una fornitura coerente dei servizi, dobbiamo garantire che i nostri processi siano ben documentati, controllati e trasparenti.

In questo contesto, stiamo cercando un profilo dedicato alla supervisione della documentazione, alla gestione delle procedure operative standard (SOP), e al monitoraggio degli accordi di livello dei servizi (SLA). Rinforzando questi pilastri di governance, ci aiuterà a garantire la continuità e la qualità delle operazioni, facilitando al contempo una chiara comunicazione e allineamento tra i nostri team tecnici e aziendali.

Principali responsabilità
- Coordinare le attività operative relative ai servizi di integrazione dei dati sotto la responsabilità di DataOps Team Manager, assicurando una gestione efficace dei cambiamenti, la garanzia della qualità, il monitoraggio SLA e la documentazione SOP completa.
- Monitorare e monitorare il funzionamento regolare dei processi aziendali critici, agendo come contatto principale per gli argomenti relativi alla SLA e alla procedura.
- Creare, mantenere e migliorare continuamente la documentazione e le procedure operative (SOP) per garantire l'allineamento con gli standard interni, i requisiti di audit e le normative applicabili.
- Collaborare a stretto contatto con IT, supporto di produzione e team di business per rafforzare la governance nei processi di integrazione dei dati e garantire la documentazione è accurata, aggiornata e costantemente applicata.
- Assicurare tracciabilità, consolidamento e aggiornamenti regolari degli indicatori di performance (KPI) relativi a SLA, qualità operativa e affidabilità dei servizi.
- Preparare e contribuire a regolari recensioni dei servizi e reporting, evidenziando rischi, problemi e opportunità di miglioramento.
- Migliorare i processi del team interno raccogliendo feedback degli stakeholder, identificando i punti di dolore e proponendo ottimizzazioni alle SOP e ai flussi di lavoro in collaborazione con il responsabile della linea.
- Supporta la gestione degli incidenti e dei problemi da una prospettiva di governance (ad esempio documentazione post-incidente, lezioni apprese, follow-up delle azioni).
- Facilitare una comunicazione efficace e un coordinamento tra i team per sostenere l'eccellenza operativa e una cultura del miglioramento continuo.

Requisiti e qualifiche
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella governance operativa, nella gestione della documentazione, nella gestione dei servizi o nei ruoli PMO all'interno di un ambiente di gestione dati o IT/operazioni (ad esempio piattaforme dati, integrazione, supporto di produzione).
- Provata esperienza nella gestione e monitoraggio di SLA e SOP, con la capacità di strutturare, validare, implementare e monitorare le procedure attraverso più stakeholder.
- Forte capacità di scrittura, organizzazione e analitica, con una capacità dimostrata di produrre documentazione chiara, concisa e pronta all'audit.
- Esperienza nel monitoraggio degli indicatori di performance (KPI), nella preparazione dei report sulla qualità dei servizi e nella presentazione dei risultati alla gestione e agli stakeholder.
- Buona comprensione dell'integrazione dei dati e degli ambienti della piattaforma di dati; la conoscenza di Kafka, Opcon orchestratore, architetture microservice e la comunicazione basata su REST è un vantaggio forte.
- Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di interagire efficacemente con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici e di facilitare il coordinamento tra i team.
- Alta attenzione ai dettagli, al rigore e all'autonomia nella gestione dei compiti e delle priorità in un ambiente dinamico.
- Buon comando dell'inglese parlato e scritto; il francese è un bene.

Attributi personali
- Responsabile e affidabile, soprattutto durante i periodi operativi critici e nel contesto di incidenti di produzione o di importanti cambiamenti.
- Metodico, strutturato e rigoroso nella documentazione, nella gestione dei processi e nel follow-up.
- Proattivo e forte giocatore di squadra, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente all'interno di team interfunzionali e internazionali.
- Curioso e motivato per imparare e crescere in un ambiente tecnologico trasformante, abbracciando il cambiamento e il miglioramento continuo.
- Confortevole sfidare lo status quo costruttivamente e proporre soluzioni pragmatiche e di rischio-consapevole.

I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, così come la ricerca di un miglioramento continuo.
- Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità.
- Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza.
- Soluzione-driven: Focusing sui risultati del cliente e il trattamento dei clienti abbastanza con una mentalità di rischio-consapevole.
- Partnership-oriented: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Assicurarsi di allegare una lettera di copertura al vostro CV durante la compilazione dell'applicazione.

Allgemeine Info
- Abteilung: DataOps / IT
- Arbeitszeit Prozentsatz: 100%
- Standort: Genf

Unsere Firma

EFG International ist eine globale private Bankengruppe, die private Bank- und Asset-Management-Dienste anbietet. Wir servieren Kunden an über 40 Standorten weltweit. EFG International bietet ein anregendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld und strebt danach, Arbeitgeber der Wahl zu sein.

Unsere Aufgabe und Mission

Unternehmerische Köpfe stärken, Wert zu schaffen – heute und für die Zukunft.

Job Description

DataOps Service & Governance Engineer

DataOps Services ist es, die zuverlässige und effiziente Wartung aller von unserer Datenplattform unterstützten Datenschnittstellen sicherzustellen. Dazu gehören ein breites Spektrum an Schnittstellen, von hochkritischen Auftragsverarbeitungsströmen bis hin zu regelmäßigen Analyse- und Berichtssystemen. Das DataOps-Team unterstützt globale Systeme, die der gesamten Gruppe weltweit dienen.

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und gut organisierten Experten, der sich unserem DataOps Team in Genf anschließt. Mit der Entwicklung unserer Plattform und Datenlandschaft ist eine robuste operative Governance immer wichtiger geworden. Mit steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen, steigenden Geschäftserwartungen für die Datenqualität und der Notwendigkeit einer konsequenten Service-Lieferung müssen wir sicherstellen, dass unsere Prozesse gut dokumentiert, kontrolliert und transparent sind.

In diesem Zusammenhang suchen wir ein Profil zur Überwachung von Dokumentationen, Verwaltung von Standard-Betriebsverfahren (SOPs) und zur Überwachung von Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Durch die Verstärkung dieser Governance-Säulen helfen Sie uns, Kontinuität und Qualität der Operationen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig eine klare Kommunikation und Ausrichtung unserer technischen und Business-Teams zu ermöglichen.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
- Koordinierung der operativen Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit den Datenintegrationsdiensten unter der Verantwortung des DataOps Team Managers, Gewährleistung eines effektiven Change Managements, Qualitätssicherung, SLA-Überwachung und umfassender SOP-Dokumentation.
- Überwachen und verfolgen Sie den reibungslosen Betrieb kritischer Geschäftsprozesse, die als primärer Ansprechpartner für SLA- und prozessbezogene Themen fungieren.
- Erstellung, Wartung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Dokumentations- und Betriebsabläufe (SOPs), um die Übereinstimmung mit internen Standards, Prüfungsanforderungen und geltenden Vorschriften zu gewährleisten.
- Mit IT, Produktionsunterstützung und Business-Teams eng zusammenarbeiten, um die Governance rund um die Prozesse der Datenintegration zu stärken und sicherzustellen, dass die Dokumentation aktuell und konsequent korrekt ist.
- Gewährleistung der Rückverfolgbarkeit, Konsolidierung und regelmäßigen Aktualisierungen von Leistungsindikatoren (KPIs) im Zusammenhang mit SLAs, Betriebsqualität und Servicesicherheit.
- Bereiten Sie sich auf regelmäßige Service-Bewertungen und Berichterstattung vor und stellen Sie Risiken, Probleme und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten dar.
- Verbessern Sie interne Teamprozesse, indem Sie Stakeholder-Feedback sammeln, Schmerzpunkte identifizieren und Optimierungen für SOPs und Workflows in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leitungsmanager vorschlagen.
- Unterstützung von Vorfall- und Problemmanagement aus einer Governance-Perspektive (z.B. Post-incident-Dokumentation, gelernte Lektionen, Aktionsnachfolge).
- Erleichterung einer effektiven Kommunikation und Koordination über Teams, um operative Exzellenz und eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung zu unterstützen.

Anforderungen und Qualifikationen
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen Governance, Dokumentationsmanagement, Servicemanagement oder PMO-Rollen in einer datengesteuerten oder IT/Betriebsumgebung (z.B. Datenplattformen, Integration, Produktionsunterstützung).
- Bewährte Erfahrungen bei der Verwaltung und Überwachung von SLAs und SOPs, mit der Fähigkeit, Verfahren über mehrere Stakeholder zu strukturieren, zu validieren, umzusetzen und zu verfolgen.
- Starke Schreib-, Organisations- und analytische Fähigkeiten, mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, klare, präzise und auditbereite Dokumentationen zu erstellen.
- Erfahrung in Tracking-Performance-Indikatoren (KPIs), der Erstellung von Service-Quality-Berichten und der Präsentation von Ergebnissen für Management und Stakeholder.
- Gutes Verständnis von Datenintegration und Datenplattform-Umgebungen; Wissen über Kafka, Opcon-Orchester, Mikroservice-Architekturen und REST-basierte Kommunikation ist ein starkes Plus.
- Starke Kommunikation und interpersonale Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern zu interagieren und die Koordination über Teams zu erleichtern.
- Hohe Aufmerksamkeit auf Detail, Strenge und Autonomie bei der Verwaltung von Aufgaben und Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
- Gutes Kommando über gesprochenes und geschriebenes Englisch; Französisch ist ein Vermögen.

Persönliche Attribute
- Verantwortlich und zuverlässig, insbesondere während kritischer Betriebszeiten und im Kontext von Produktionsvorfällen oder großen Veränderungen.
- Methodisch, strukturiert und streng in Dokumentation, Prozessmanagement und Follow-up.
- Proactive und ein starker Teamplayer, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Teams zu arbeiten.
- Neugierig und motiviert, in einem sich verändernden technologischen Umfeld zu lernen und zu wachsen, Veränderung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu ermöglichen.
- Bequeme Herausforderung des Status quo konstruktiv und pragmatische, risikobewusste Lösungen.

Unsere Werte
- Rechenschaftspflicht: Eigentum an Aufgaben und Herausforderungen zu nehmen, sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu suchen.
- Hands-on: Als proaktiv, schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern.
- Leidenschaftlich: Sein Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz.
- Lösungsgetrieben: Konzentrieren Sie sich auf Client-Ergebnisse und Behandlung von Clients ziemlich mit einem risikobewussten Mindset.
- Partnerschaftsorientiert: Förderung von Zusammenarbeit und Teamarbeit. Zusammenarbeit mit einem Unternehmergeist.

Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie beim Ausfüllen der Bewerbung einen Brief an Ihren Lebenslauf anbringen.

Informations générales
- Département: DataOps / IT
- Temps de travail Pourcentage: 100%
- Lieu: Genève

Notre société

EFG International est un groupe mondial de banques privées qui offre des services de banque privée et de gestion d'actifs. Nous servons des clients dans plus de 40 endroits dans le monde. EFG International offre un environnement de travail stimulant et dynamique et s'efforce d'être un employeur de choix.

Notre but et notre mission

Autoriser les esprits entrepreneurs à créer de la valeur – aujourd'hui et pour l'avenir.

Description de l'emploi

DataOps Ingénieur de service et de gouvernance

La mission de DataOps Services est d'assurer le service fiable et efficace de toutes les interfaces de données prises en charge par notre plateforme de données. Cela comprend un large éventail d'interfaces, allant des flux de traitement des commandes hautement critiques aux systèmes d'analyse et de rapport réguliers. L'équipe DataOps prend en charge les systèmes mondiaux desservant l'ensemble du Groupe dans le monde entier.

Nous recherchons un expert fiable et bien organisé pour rejoindre notre équipe DataOps à Genève. À mesure que notre plateforme et notre paysage de données évoluent, une gouvernance opérationnelle robuste devient de plus en plus importante. Compte tenu des exigences réglementaires croissantes, des attentes croissantes de l'entreprise en matière de qualité des données et de la nécessité d'assurer une prestation uniforme des services, nous devons nous assurer que nos processus sont bien documentés, contrôlés et transparents.

Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons un profil dédié à la supervision de la documentation, à la gestion des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et à la surveillance des ententes sur les niveaux de service (APS). En renforçant ces piliers de gouvernance, vous nous aiderez à assurer la continuité et la qualité des opérations, tout en facilitant une communication et un alignement clairs entre nos équipes techniques et commerciales.

Principales responsabilités
- Coordonner les activités opérationnelles liées aux services d'intégration des données sous la responsabilité du gestionnaire de l'équipe DataOps, en assurant une gestion efficace du changement, l'assurance de la qualité, la surveillance de l'ALS et la documentation complète de l'APS.
- Surveiller et suivre le bon fonctionnement des processus opérationnels critiques, en agissant comme premier contact pour les sujets liés aux ALS et aux procédures.
- Créer, maintenir et améliorer continuellement la documentation et les procédures opérationnelles (PON) pour assurer l'alignement sur les normes internes, les exigences de vérification et les règlements applicables.
- Collaborer étroitement avec l'informatique, le soutien à la production et les équipes d'affaires pour renforcer la gouvernance autour des processus d'intégration des données et s'assurer que la documentation est exacte, à jour et appliquée de façon cohérente.
- Assurer la traçabilité, la consolidation et les mises à jour régulières des indicateurs de rendement (ICP) liés aux ALS, à la qualité opérationnelle et à la fiabilité du service.
- Préparer et contribuer à l'examen régulier des services et à l'établissement de rapports, en soulignant les risques, les problèmes et les possibilités d'amélioration.
- Améliorer les processus internes de l'équipe en recueillant les commentaires des parties prenantes, en identifiant les points de douleur et en proposant des optimisations aux SOP et aux workflows en collaboration avec le gestionnaire de ligne.
- Soutenir la gestion des incidents et des problèmes du point de vue de la gouvernance (p. ex. documentation postincident, leçons apprises, suivi de l'action).
- Faciliter une communication et une coordination efficaces entre les équipes afin de soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle et une culture d'amélioration continue.

Exigences et qualifications
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la gouvernance opérationnelle, la gestion de la documentation, la gestion des services ou les rôles du BGP dans un environnement axé sur les données ou l'informatique/opérations (p. ex. plates-formes de données, intégration, soutien à la production).
- Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion et le suivi des SLA et des SOP, avec la capacité de structurer, valider, mettre en œuvre et suivre les procédures entre plusieurs intervenants.
- De solides compétences en rédaction, en organisation et en analyse, avec une capacité démontrée de produire une documentation claire, concise et prête à l'audit.
- Expérience du suivi des indicateurs de rendement (ICP), de la préparation des rapports sur la qualité des services et de la présentation des conclusions à la direction et aux intervenants.
- Bonne compréhension de l'intégration des données et des environnements de plate-forme de données; la connaissance de Kafka, d'orchestreur Opcon, d'architectures de microservices et de communication basée sur REST est un plus fort.
- Fortes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques et de faciliter la coordination entre les équipes.
- Une grande attention au détail, à la rigueur et à l'autonomie dans la gestion des tâches et des priorités dans un environnement dynamique.
- Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit; le français est un atout.

Attributs personnels
- Responsable et fiable, en particulier pendant les périodes opérationnelles critiques et dans le contexte des incidents de production ou des changements majeurs.
- Méthode, structure et rigueur dans la documentation, la gestion des processus et le suivi.
- Un joueur d'équipe proactif et fort, capable de travailler efficacement au sein d'équipes interfonctionnelles et internationales.
- Curieux et motivé à apprendre et à grandir dans un environnement technologique en transformation, intégrant le changement et l'amélioration continue.
- Confortable défier le statu quo de manière constructive et proposer des solutions pragmatiques et conscientes des risques.

Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : prise en charge des tâches et des défis, et recherche d'amélioration continue.
- Hands-on: être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité.
- Passionné : être engagé et viser l'excellence.
- La solution est axée sur les résultats des clients et le traitement équitable des clients avec un état d'esprit conscient des risques.
- Objectif partenariat : promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

DataOps Service & Governance Engineer

DataOps Services’ mission is to ensure the reliable and efficient servicing of all data interfaces supported by our data platform. This includes a broad spectrum of interfaces, ranging from highly critical order-processing flows to regular analytical and reporting systems. The DataOps team supports global systems serving the entire Group worldwide.

We are looking for a reliable and well-organised expert to join our DataOps team in Geneva. As our platform and data landscape evolve, robust operational governance has become increasingly important. With growing regulatory requirements, rising business expectations for data quality, and the need for consistent service delivery, we must ensure that our processes are well-documented, controlled, and transparent.

In this context, we are seeking a profile dedicated to overseeing documentation, managing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring Service Level Agreements (SLAs). By reinforcing these governance pillars, you will help us ensure continuity and quality of operations, while facilitating clear communication and alignment among our technical and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate operational activities related to data integration services under the responsibility of the DataOps Team Manager, ensuring effective change management, quality assurance, SLA monitoring, and comprehensive SOP documentation.
  • Monitor and track the smooth operation of critical business processes, acting as the primary contact for SLA- and procedure-related topics.
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation and operational procedures (SOPs) to ensure alignment with internal standards, audit requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, production support, and business teams to strengthen governance around data integration processes and ensure documentation is accurate, up to date, and consistently applied.
  • Ensure traceability, consolidation, and regular updates of performance indicators (KPIs) related to SLAs, operational quality, and service reliability.
  • Prepare and contribute to regular service reviews and reporting, highlighting risks, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Improve internal team processes by gathering stakeholder feedback, identifying pain points, and proposing optimisations to SOPs and workflows in collaboration with the line manager.
  • Support incident and problem management from a governance perspective (e.g. post-incident documentation, lessons learned, action follow-up).
  • Facilitate effective communication and coordination across teams to support operational excellence and a culture of continuous improvement.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience in operational governance, documentation management, service management, or PMO roles within a data-driven or IT/operations environment (e.g. data platforms, integration, production support).
  • Proven experience in managing and monitoring SLAs and SOPs, with the ability to structure, validate, implement, and track procedures across multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong writing, organisational, and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to produce clear, concise, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Experience in tracking performance indicators (KPIs), preparing service quality reports, and presenting findings to management and stakeholders.
  • Good understanding of data integration and data platform environments; knowledge of Kafka, Opcon orchestrator, microservice architectures, and REST-based communication is a strong plus.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to facilitate coordination across teams.
  • High attention to detail, rigor, and autonomy in managing tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Good command of spoken and written English; French is an asset.

Personal Attributes

  • Responsible and reliable, especially during critical operational periods and in the context of production incidents or major changes.
  • Methodical, structured, and rigorous in documentation, process management, and follow-up.
  • Proactive and a strong team player, with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional and international teams.
  • Curious and motivated to learn and grow in a transforming technological environment, embracing change and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable challenging the status quo constructively and proposing pragmatic, risk-aware solutions.

Our Values

  • Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.
  • Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.
  • Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.
  • Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.
